title: senna septemtrionalis
intro: Senna septemtrionalis, commonly known as Canadian senna, is a flowering plant native to the north-eastern parts of North America. It is a member of the Fabaceae family and has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Senna septemtrionalis include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve constipation, and lower blood sugar levels due to its antidiabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of Senna septemtrionalis include anthraquinones, such as aloe-emodin and chrysophanol, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including laxative and anti-inflammatory effects.
